title: Lautaro Martínez: already a top-five Inter striker? THE DEBATE No. 10
caption:
Is Lautaro Martínez already a top-five Inter striker — or is that selling him short?
Lautaro Martínez, 2018–: 181 goals for Inter, third all-time, 3 Scudetti, Capocannoniere in 2024 and 2026, the club's top Champions League scorer.
Alessandro Altobelli, 1977–88: 209 goals in 466 games, second all-time, Scudetto 1980, two Coppa Italia, World Cup winner 1982.
We picked. Who's yours?
